quick_english: Whoever knows me as unborn, beginningless, and great lord of the world, being undeluded, is freed from all sins among mortals.
Intelligence, knowledge, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calm, pleasure, pain, becoming, being, fear, fearlessness, non-delusion, and zeal are listed.

You should tell completely the auspicious glories of yourself, by which glories you pervade and stand in all these worlds.
How may I know you, O yogi, while I consider you? In which and which states are you to be thought, O Lord, by me?

quick_english: I am the self, Guḍākeśa, dwelling in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, middle, and indeed the end of beings.
cite_parts: ahamādiśca madhyaṃ  ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca

quick_english: Among Ādityas I am Viṣṇu, among lights the sun with rays; among Maruts I am Marīci, and among stars I am the moon.
Among Vedas I am the Sāmaveda; among gods I am Vāsava; among senses I am mind; among beings I am consciousness.
Among Rudras I am Śaṅkara; among Yakṣas and Rākṣasas I am the lord of wealth; among Vasus I am fire; among peaks I am Meru.
And know, Pārtha, Bṛhaspati as chief among priests; among army leaders I am Skanda; among rivers I am the ocean.
Among great sages I am Bhṛgu; among speeches the one imperishable syllable; among sacrifices the sacrifice of muttered prayer; among immovable things Himalaya.

tokens.quick_gloss: I am the sacrifice of muttered prayer

quick_english: Among all trees the sacred fig tree; among divine sages Nārada; among gandharvas Citraratha; among perfected ones Kapila the sage.
Know me as the swift one among horses, Airāvata among lordly elephants, and the lord of men among men.
I am the thunderbolt among weapons, the wish-cow among cows, Kandarpa as procreation, and Vāsuki among serpents.
I am Ananta among serpents, Varuṇa among aquatic beings, Aryaman among ancestors, and Yama among controllers.
I am Prahlāda among daityas, time among those who reckon, the lion king among beasts, and Vainateya among birds.

tokens.quick_gloss: I am of those who reckon

quick_english: I am the wind among purifiers, Rama among weapon-bearers, the makara among fishes, and the Ganga among rivers.

quick_english: Among the Vṛṣṇis I am Vāsudeva; among the Pāṇḍavas, Dhanañjaya; among sages, Vyāsa; among poets, Uśanas the poet.
I am the rod among punishers, policy among conquerors; and indeed I am silence among secrets, knowledge among knowers.
Whatever is the seed of all beings, that I am, Arjuna; nothing exists without me, no being moving or still.
cite_parts: na tadasti vinā  yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram

quick_english: There is no end, Parantapa, to my divine glories; this extent of glory has been spoken by me briefly.
Whatever being is glorious, splendid, or mighty, know that very thing, you, to be born of a spark of my splendor.

Or else, what is the use of much knowledge for you, Arjuna? Supporting this whole world, I stand with one part. I am the Self. This teaching prevents a distinction that would otherwise break the vision of Brahman; all this is the Lord's principle, manifested in various forms and becoming the object of all.
